assertions.description: 车载端的会话经协议故障代理建立（否则断开注入不到这条链路上）
重连后服务端在等这次装货的结果：新代次、RecoveryRequired、PENDING_FACT_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED，待对账 attempt 含本次装货（CV-CONNECTION-LOSS-SAFE-FINISH 的 NEVER_READY_BEFORE_RECONCILIATION）
assertions.expected: gen > 1 / RecoveryRequired / PENDING_FACT_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED / pending 含 b85f795e-6737-1855-932a-68b6444a7584
assertions.actual: 断 1 条 / gen 2 / RecoveryRequired / PENDING_FACT_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED / pendingAttempts ["b85f795e-6737-1855-932a-68b6444a7584"] / pendingResults [] / unsettled b85f795e-6737-1855-932a-68b6444a7584 / checkpoint ACTIVE_UNLOCK_SET / activeUnlock [1]

assertions.description: 装货在车上结束后，这次装货的 OperationResult 在第一次重连后的这一代次内送达服务端并被受理，会话回到 Ready、装货 Committed（ADR-cross-0028／0029：未就绪期间允许结果补报；不靠第二次断线）
assertions.expected: CLOSED/OCCUPIED/1/0 / gen 2 内结果 >= 1 / gen 2 Ready / Committed
assertions.actual: CLOSED/OCCUPIED/1/0 / gen 2 内结果 1（共 1） / gen 2 / RecoveryRequired / PENDING_FACT_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED / pendingAttempts ["b85f795e-6737-1855-932a-68b6444a7584"] / pendingResults [] / unsettled b85f795e-6737-1855-932a-68b6444a7584 / checkpoint ACTIVE_UNLOCK_SET / activeUnlock [1] / Prepared

assertions.description: （守护）RecoveryRequired 期间，这次装货的核对／收尾阶段 OperationProgress 仍不发（ADR 只放行结果补报，进度是遥测）
（探针）第二次断线重连后，结果在服务端、会话回 Ready、装货 Committed、旅程离开装货段
assertions.expected: 结果 >= 1 / gen > 2 Ready / Committed / AwaitingStationDeparture 或 AwaitingDepartureSafety 或 AwaitingGateArrival
assertions.actual: 断 1 条 / 结果 1 / gen 3 / Ready / READY / pendingAttempts [] / pendingResults [] / unsettled  / checkpoint RESULT_RECORDED / activeUnlock [] / Prepared / AwaitingLoadResult

assertions.description: 同一 attempt 至多一条 OperationResult（服务端收件箱按 messageId 一行），不重复结算
（观察，hmi#124 线索）全程没有 ProtocolProblem；重连后的连接上服务端发过的行程快照条数照实记录
assertions.actual: 0 ProtocolProblem () / 重连后行程快照 1 条 (#3 CurrentStopWorklistSnapshot)
